spellbook.finance/limitations: Workspace membership remains backend-enforced, and rows come from every workspace partition this customer owns.

buyPrice and salesTaxUsd are decimal strings the customer supplied. They are submitted evidence, never a verified merchant order. buyPrice is null when parent basis is unallocated; incrementalCashCostUsd can still be 0.00.
currentMarketPrice is a modeled sealed market price and is null when no recent quote exists. A null price contributes nothing to a total.
evAtPurchase is the EV modeled on the acquisition date, not today's EV, so the difference between them is not a realized gain.

openIntentQuantity records a plan to open, not a physical opening. opened marks opened history; openedAt is null when the physical opening date is unknown. heldQuantity counts live units excluded from sealed publication.
acquisitionSource is customer-supplied and can be null or mixed. An extension source proves capture through the extension, not delivery.
recoveredAt is the intake record time for recovered components, not their historical recovery date. recoveryDateEstimate is approximate.
This route returns every sealed row at once and does not page, so a very large sealed portfolio is bounded only by the response size.

description: Read a seller's sealed boxes, packs and cases, with quantity, cost basis, market price, heldQuantity, openIntentQuantity, acquisitionSource and workspaceId for each purchase entry. Call this to reconcile physical sealed stock before listing or opening it. Recovered components can have unknown allocated cost basis and an approximate recovery date. A hold differs from an actual opening; call spellbook_sealed_portfolio_hold_set to correct a holding mark.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose sealed positions to read, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required.
